# TALVUMI Pet Nutrition

> TALVUMI is an export-facing pet nutrition brand developing a focused premium cat and dog food range for qualified international importers, distributors, retail chains, specialist pet retailers and ecommerce operators.

## Verified facts

- Brand: TALVUMI
- Website: https://talvumi.com/
- Category: cat food, dog food and pet nutrition
- Commercial model: wholesale and distribution first; retail opens market by market
- Initial commercial candidates: adult cat ocean fish recipe, adult dog beef recipe and kitten ocean fish recipe
- Product status: formulas, claims, pack sizes and availability remain subject to manufacturer documentation, market registration and written commercial confirmation
- Partner types: importers, national and regional distributors, retail chains, specialist pet retailers and ecommerce operators
- Territory policy: exclusivity and commercial terms require capability review and a written agreement
